shell.footer: Subtitles and notes on the Hub are shared by members, each under its own licence. For copyright or privacy issues, file a takedown request.

common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the text instead

errors.network_error: Can't reach the Hub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in to the Hub first.
errors.forbidden: You don't have the permission this needs.
errors.not_found: Not found, or you can't see it.
errors.removed: This version was removed after a takedown request.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.own_version: You can't vote on a version you uploaded.
errors.account_too_new: Accounts younger than 24 hours can't vote or report yet.
errors.already_reported: You already reported this version; wait until a moderator handles it.
errors.version_hidden: This version is hidden; you can't vote on or report it.
errors.last_identity: This is your only sign-in method, so it can't be removed.
errors.provider_already_linked: This account already has that sign-in method.
errors.admin_by_config: Admins can only be set in the config file or with notesteme-hub admin grant.
errors.takedown_decided: This takedown request was already decided.
errors.csrf_invalid: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.session_required: This can only be done while signed in to the Hub website.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page was removed.

login.title: Sign in to the Hub
login.intro: Sign in with any of these accounts. Your first sign-in creates a Hub account.
login.none: This Hub has no sign-in method enabled yet. Contact the admin.
login.noEmailMerge: Signing in with a different method for the first time creates a separate account. To use several, sign in and link them on the Account page.
login.takedown: No account needed: file a takedown request

browse.title: Browse shared subtitles and notes
browse.intro: Filter by platform, channel, language and models to find a version you trust.
browse.videoHint: e.g. youtube:dQw4w9WgXcQ; add /p2 for a part
browse.excludeUnverified: Hide versions whose models weren't recorded by a client
browse.empty: Nothing has been shared yet. Use “Share to Hub” on an item in your Notesteme client.

version.title: Version
version.hiddenNotice: This version is hidden while reports are pending; only its uploaders and moderators can see it.
version.needDownload: Sign in with download permission to download and preview the content.
version.regenerateHint: Paste this version ID in your Notesteme client under Settings → Hub to rerun correction, translation and notes from these raw subtitles without paying for transcription.
version.badContent: The content isn't in a valid format and can't be shown.

community.signInToVote: Sign in to vote and report.
community.notVisible: This version can't be voted on or reported right now.
community.hideHint: Hidden versions leave lists and lookups; only uploaders and moderators can see them. There's no unhide action yet: it comes back only when a later report is dismissed.
community.reportHint: Moderators see your name; uploaders and others don't. For copyright or privacy, file a takedown request instead.
community.useTakedown: Use a takedown request for copyright and privacy issues.

video.compareHint: Tick two subtitle versions to compare them side by side on a shared timeline.
video.compareNeedsDownload: Sign in with download permission to compare subtitles side by side.

takedown.title: Takedown request
takedown.intro: Rights holders or affected people can ask for a version to be removed, without an account. Check the result with your request number; no email is sent.
takedown.versionHint: The last part of the version page's address
takedown.emailHint: Only moderators can see it; stored encrypted.
takedown.goodFaith: I state in good faith that this request is accurate.
takedown.sentBody: Request number {{id}}. Keep it to check the result later.
takedown.lookup: Already filed? Enter your request number

identities.title: Sign-in methods
identities.hint: Once linked, any of them signs you in to this account. Linking needs a sign-in within the last 10 minutes.
identities.reauth: Sign in again before linking a new method.
identities.removeHint: You won't be able to sign in with it until you link it again.

tokens.title: Hub tokens
tokens.intro: For your Notesteme client and MCP. A token never has more than your account; it stops working if the account is suspended.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeHint: Clients and MCP using it lose access right away. This can't be undone.
tokens.createdHint: This is the only time the token is shown. Copy it into your client under Settings → Hub.

shares.title: My shares
shares.withdrawHint: Versions nobody else shared disappear from the Hub; versions others derived from them stay.

reports.dismissTitle: Dismiss the reports on this version?
reports.dismissHint: All open reports on this version close, and a hidden version becomes visible again.
reports.removeHint: The version is removed and the same content can't be uploaded again; uploaders see the reason. This can't be undone.

takedowns.empty: No takedown requests in this state.
takedowns.rejectHint: The version stays; the requester will see “Rejected”.
takedowns.removeHint: The version and files only it uses are deleted, and the same content can't be uploaded again. This can't be undone.

users.groupHint: A group from the config file; admins can only be set there.

hint.add: Manual memberships aren't affected by automatic rules.
hint.remove: Only the manual membership is removed; config and rule memberships stay.
hint.suspend: While suspended, the account can't sign in or use tokens and its votes don't count. Give a reason (1–500 characters).
hint.unsuspend: Existing sessions and tokens are revoked; the person signs in again and creates new tokens.
